title: Remove the legacy document-archive command
description:
Remove `jit doc archive` as a clean cut with no alias or compatibility stub. Remove its CLI and main dispatch, `archive_document`, `ArchiveResult`, obsolete event catalog/schema references, tests and fixtures, and all adopter-facing docs/README references. Regenerate and test the MCP tool set so the removed subcommand disappears. Retire the legacy `[documentation.categories]` loader field, documentation, and this repository's config entries in the same change; archival has no category input and uses only the repository-relative mirror layout. Historical development records may remain clearly historical. `crates/server` and `web` require verification but have no expected live command consumer.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A tree-wide search for `doc archive`, `archive_document`, and `ArchiveResult` across `crates/`, `mcp-server/`, `web/`, `docs/`, and `dev/` finds no live production or test reference; only clearly historical `dev/` records may mention the removed surface, the generated MCP schema/tests expose no legacy tool, `[documentation.categories]` has no live loader/config/docs reference, and all affected Rust and MCP tests pass.
